title: Rematch Trainers
description: A guide to rematch trainers in Polished Crystal
html:
Fighting Dojo

After defeating Blue, Gym Leaders visit the Fighting Dojo in Saffron City on a daily rotating schedule. Available after obtaining all 16 badges.

Special guest trainers are not all shown here. For Cynthia, Steven, Marlon, Piers, Lorelei, and other one-off guest battles, see the Special Trainers guide.

Trainers registered in your PokéGear can be called for rematches on specific days.
